Draft an update email to John Paul Const.text:
Here’s a draft progress update to John Paul Construction on Dexcom, built from this week’s live numbers. Edit, copy, or send it to the approval queue.

To
John Paul Construction
Subject
Dexcom campus, Athenry: progress update, week commencing 5 October
Hi John Paul team,

A short update on the rainwater drainage package at Dexcom campus. We are now 76% complete, with 1,791 m of the 2,356 m designed installed to date (siphonic 967 m, gravity 824 m).

Last week the team installed 79 m, and a further 69 m is in so far this week against 85 m planned. IE Crew 2 is on site, led by Barry McEvoy.

Next steps:
- Building 2 siphonic water test on Wed 14 Oct. We will confirm the time with your site team a couple of days ahead.
- Continued collector and stack installation in line with the current programme.

If anything changes on your side, or you would like to walk the roof together, just let me know.

Kind regards,

Donnacha Tobin
Operations Director
Capcon Engineering Ltd, Maynooth, Co. Kildare
